description-zh: PHP程序的入口函数示例，包含命令行参数处理和错误处理
description-en: Entry point function example for PHP programs, including command line arguments and error handling
code:
<?php

/**
 * 主程序入口函数
 * @param array $argv 命令行参数数组
 * @return int 退出状态码
 */
function main(array $argv = []): int {
    try {
        // 设置错误处理
        set_error_handler(function($severity, $message, $file, $line) {
            throw new ErrorException($message, 0, $severity, $file, $line);
        });
        
        // 打印程序信息
        echo "Program: {$argv[0]}\n";
        
        // 打印命令行参数
        $args = array_slice($argv, 1);
        echo "Arguments count: " . count($args) . "\n";
        echo "Arguments: " . implode(', ', $args) . "\n";
        
        // 程序主要逻辑
        $name = $args[0] ?? 'World';
        echo "Hello, {$name}!\n";
        
        return 0;
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "Error: {$e->getMessage()}\n");
        return 1;
    }
}

// 如果是从命令行运行
if (PHP_SAPI === 'cli' && basename($argv[0]) === basename(__FILE__)) {
    exit(main($argv));
}

description-en: Return an array without duplicates preserving order
code:
<?php
function array_unique_order(array $arr): array {
    $seen = [];
    $out = [];
    foreach ($arr as $v) {
        if (!isset($seen[$v])) {
            $seen[$v] = true;
            $out[] = $v;
        }
    }
    return $out;
}

description-zh: 使用生成器逐行读取文件（内存友好）
description-en: Yield lines from file efficiently using generator
code:
<?php
function file_line_generator(string $filename): \Generator {
    if (!is_readable($filename)) return;
    $fh = fopen($filename, 'rb');
    if (!$fh) return;
    try {
        while (($line = fgets($fh)) !== false) {
            yield rtrim($line, "\r\n");
        }
    } finally {
        fclose($fh);
    }
}

description-zh: 在非负权图上用最小堆求单源最短路
description-en: Single-source shortest path on non-negative graph using min-heap
code:
<?php
// adj[u] = list of [v, w]
function dijkstra_shortest_path(int $n, array $adj, int $src): array {
    $INF = PHP_INT_MAX;
    $dist = array_fill(0, $n, $INF);
    $dist[$src] = 0;
    // simple binary heap via SplPriorityQueue (invert priorities for min-heap)
    $pq = new SplPriorityQueue();
    $pq->setExtractFlags(SplPriorityQueue::EXTR_BOTH);
    $pq->insert($src, 0 - 0);
    while (!$pq->isEmpty()) {
        $cur = $pq->extract();
        $u = $cur['data'];
        $d = 0 - $cur['priority'];
        if ($d !== $dist[$u]) continue;
        foreach ($adj[$u] as [$v, $w]) {
            $nd = $d + $w;
            if ($nd < $dist[$v]) { $dist[$v] = $nd; $pq->insert($v, 0 - $nd); }
        }
    }
    return $dist;
}

description-zh: Kruskal+并查集计算MST总权(不连通返回-1)
description-en: Kruskal with DSU to compute MST total weight (-1 if disconnected)
code:
<?php
// edges: list of [u,v,w]
function kruskal_mst(int $n, array $edges): int {
    usort($edges, fn($a,$b) => $a[2] <=> $b[2]);
    $p = range(0, $n-1); $r = array_fill(0,$n,0);
    $find = function($x) use (&$p, &$find) { return $p[$x]===$x ? $x : ($p[$x]=$find($p[$x])); };
    $unite = function($a,$b) use (&$p,&$r,$find){ $a=$find($a); $b=$find($b); if($a===$b) return false; if($r[$a]<$r[$b]) [$a,$b]=[$b,$a]; $p[$b]=$a; if($r[$a]===$r[$b]) $r[$a]++; return true; };
    $total=0; $cnt=0;
    foreach ($edges as [$u,$v,$w]) { if($unite($u,$v)){ $total += $w; if(++$cnt === $n-1) break; } }
    return $cnt === $n-1 ? $total : -1;
}

description-zh: 允许负边权的单源最短路；检测负环
description-en: Single-source shortest path with negative edges; detect negative cycles
code:
<?php
// edges: list of [u,v,w]
function bellman_ford(int $n, array $edges, int $src): array {
    $INF = PHP_INT_MAX;
    $dist = array_fill(0, $n, $INF);
    $dist[$src] = 0;
    for ($i=1; $i<=$n-1; $i++) {
        $updated = false;
        foreach ($edges as [$u,$v,$w]) {
            if ($dist[$u] !== $INF && $dist[$u] + $w < $dist[$v]) { $dist[$v] = $dist[$u] + $w; $updated = true; }
        }
        if (!$updated) break;
    }
    foreach ($edges as [$u,$v,$w]) { if ($dist[$u] !== $INF && $dist[$u] + $w < $dist[$v]) return [$dist, true]; }
    return [$dist, false];
}

description-zh: 入度法Kahn算法返回拓扑序列
description-en: Kahn algorithm using indegrees to return topo order
code:
<?php
function topo_sort_kahn(int $n, array $adj): array {
    $indeg = array_fill(0,$n,0);
    for($u=0;$u<$n;$u++){ foreach($adj[$u] as $v){ $indeg[$v]++; } }
    $q = [];
    for($i=0;$i<$n;$i++) if($indeg[$i]===0) $q[]=$i;
    $order = [];
    for($h=0; $h<count($q); $h++){ $u=$q[$h]; $order[]=$u; foreach($adj[$u] as $v){ if(--$indeg[$v]===0) $q[]=$v; } }
    return $order;
}

description-zh: 返回所有匹配起始下标
description-en: Return all match start indices
code:
<?php
function kmp_search(string $text, string $pat): array {
    $n=strlen($text); $m=strlen($pat); if($m===0) return [];
    $lps=array_fill(0,$m,0);
    for($i=1,$len=0;$i<$m;){ if($pat[$i]===$pat[$len]){ $lps[$i++]=++$len; } elseif($len>0){ $len=$lps[$len-1]; } else { $lps[$i++]=0; } }
    $res=[];
    for($i=0,$j=0;$i<$n;){ if($text[$i]===$pat[$j]){ $i++; $j++; if($j===$m){ $res[]=$i-$m; $j=$lps[$j-1]; } } elseif($j>0){ $j=$lps[$j-1]; } else { $i++; } }
    return $res;
}

description-zh: 滚动哈希匹配，返回所有匹配位置
description-en: Rolling-hash matching, return all indices
code:
<?php
function rabin_karp(string $text, string $pat): array {
    $n=strlen($text); $m=strlen($pat); if($m===0 || $m>$n) return [];
    $B=131; $MOD=1000000007;
    $powB=1; for($i=0;$i<$m-1;$i++) $powB=($powB*$B)%$MOD;
    $hpat=0; $hwin=0;
    for($i=0;$i<$m;$i++){ $hpat=($hpat*$B+ord($pat[$i]))%$MOD; $hwin=($hwin*$B+ord($text[$i]))%$MOD; }
    $out=[];
    for($i=0;$i<=$n-$m;$i++){
        if($hpat===$hwin && substr($text,$i,$m)===$pat) $out[]=$i;
        if($i<$n-$m){ $hwin = (($hwin - ord($text[$i])*$powB)%$MOD + $MOD)%$MOD; $hwin = ($hwin*$B + ord($text[$i+$m]))%$MOD; }
    }
    return $out;
}

function sieve_is_prime(int $n): array {
    $is = array_fill(0,$n+1,1);
    if($n>=0) $is[0]=0; if($n>=1) $is[1]=0;
    for($p=2; $p*$p<=$n; $p++) if($is[$p]){ for($x=$p*$p; $x<=$n; $x+=$p) $is[$x]=0; }
    return $is;
}

description-zh: 动态规划计算编辑距离(滚动数组)
description-en: DP edit distance with rolling array
code:
<?php
function edit_distance(string $a, string $b): int {
    $m=strlen($a); $n=strlen($b);
    $prev=array_fill(0,$n+1,0); $cur=array_fill(0,$n+1,0);
    for($j=0;$j<=$n;$j++) $prev[$j]=$j;
    for($i=1;$i<=$m;$i++){
        $cur[0]=$i; $ai=$a[$i-1];
        for($j=1;$j<=$n;$j++){
            $cost = ($ai===$b[$j-1]) ? 0 : 1;
            $del=$prev[$j]+1; $ins=$cur[$j-1]+1; $rep=$prev[$j-1]+$cost;
            $cur[$j]=min($del,$ins,$rep);
        }
        [$prev,$cur]=[$cur,$prev];
    }
    return $prev[$n];
}

name-zh: 最长上升子序列O(n log n)
description-zh: 耐心排序+二分求LIS长度
description-en: Patience sorting + binary search for LIS length
code:
<?php
function lis_length(array $a): int {
    $tails = [];
    foreach ($a as $x) {
        $i = lower_bound($tails, $x);
        $tails[$i] = $x;
    }
    return count($tails);
}
function lower_bound(array $arr, $x): int {
    $l=0; $r=count($arr);
    while($l<$r){ $m=($l+$r)>>1; if($arr[$m]>=$x) $r=$m; else $l=$m+1; }
    return $l;
}

description-zh: 平均线性时间找到第k小(1<=k<=n)
description-en: Find k-th smallest in average linear time (1<=k<=n)
code:
<?php
function quickselect(array $a, int $k): int { // k: 1-based
    $l=0; $r=count($a)-1; $k--;
    while($l<=$r){
        $pivot=$a[$r]; $i=$l;
        for($j=$l;$j<$r;$j++){ if($a[$j]<=$pivot){ [$a[$i],$a[$j]] = [$a[$j],$a[$i]]; $i++; } }
        [$a[$i],$a[$r]] = [$a[$r],$a[$i]];
        if($i===$k) return $a[$i]; elseif($i>$k) $r=$i-1; else $l=$i+1;
    }
    throw new InvalidArgumentException('k out of range');
}

name-zh: LRU 缓存(哈希+双向链表)
description-zh: O(1) 时间支持 get/put 的最近最少使用缓存，使用自建双向链表维护顺序+哈希表定位
description-en: Least Recently Used cache with O(1) get/put using custom doubly-linked list and hash map
code:
<?php
/**
 * LRU 缓存: get/put 均为 O(1)
 * 通过一个双端链表维护最近使用顺序 + 哈希表(key=>节点)定位。
 * 这里用 SplDoublyLinkedList 存储 [key,value]，同时 map 里保存 key => nodeIndex。
 * 注意: SplDoublyLinkedList 不支持 O(1) 任意位置删除/移动，这里采用自建链表节点类以获得稳定 O(1)。
 */
class LRUNode {
    public $key; public $val; public $prev = null; public $next = null;
    public function __construct($key, $val){ $this->key=$key; $this->val=$val; }
}

class LRUCache {
    private int $capacity;
    private array $map = []; // key => LRUNode
    private ?LRUNode $head = null; // dummy head
    private ?LRUNode $tail = null; // dummy tail

    public function __construct(int $capacity){
        if ($capacity <= 0) throw new InvalidArgumentException('capacity must be > 0');
        $this->capacity = $capacity;
        $this->head = new LRUNode(null, null);
        $this->tail = new LRUNode(null, null);
        $this->head->next = $this->tail;
        $this->tail->prev = $this->head;
    }

    private function addToFront(LRUNode $node): void {
        $node->prev = $this->head;
        $node->next = $this->head->next;
        $this->head->next->prev = $node;
        $this->head->next = $node;
    }

    private function removeNode(LRUNode $node): void {
        $prev = $node->prev; $next = $node->next;
        if ($prev) $prev->next = $next;
        if ($next) $next->prev = $prev;
        $node->prev = $node->next = null;
    }

    private function moveToFront(LRUNode $node): void {
        $this->removeNode($node);
        $this->addToFront($node);
    }

    private function popTail(): ?LRUNode {
        $node = $this->tail->prev;
        if ($node === $this->head) return null;
        $this->removeNode($node);
        return $node;
    }

    public function get($key){
        if (!isset($this->map[$key])) return null;
        $node = $this->map[$key];
        $this->moveToFront($node);
        return $node->val;
    }

    public function put($key, $value): void {
        if (isset($this->map[$key])) {
            $node = $this->map[$key];
            $node->val = $value;
            $this->moveToFront($node);
            return;
        }
        $node = new LRUNode($key, $value);
        $this->map[$key] = $node;
        $this->addToFront($node);
        if (count($this->map) > $this->capacity) {
            $old = $this->popTail();
            if ($old && $old->key !== null) { unset($this->map[$old->key]); }
        }
    }
}

// 使用示例:
// $lru = new LRUCache(2);
// $lru->put('a', 1); $lru->put('b', 2);
// $lru->get('a');        // 1，并将 'a' 移到最近
// $lru->put('c', 3);     // 淘汰 'b'
// $lru->get('b');        // null

description-zh: 栈支持 push/pop/top 并以 O(1) 返回最小值，使用辅助栈保存当前最小值
description-en: Stack supporting push/pop/top and O(1) getMin using an auxiliary stack
code:
<?php
class MinStack {
    private array $stk = [];
    private array $minStk = [];

    public function push($x): void {
        $this->stk[] = $x;
        if (empty($this->minStk)) {
            $this->minStk[] = $x;
        } else {
            $m = end($this->minStk);
            $this->minStk[] = ($x < $m) ? $x : $m;
        }
    }

    public function pop(){
        if (empty($this->stk)) return null;
        array_pop($this->minStk);
        return array_pop($this->stk);
    }

    public function top(){
        return empty($this->stk) ? null : end($this->stk);
    }

    public function getMin(){
        return empty($this->minStk) ? null : end($this->minStk);
    }
}

description-en: Iterate all files in directory using generator
code:
<?php
function dir_iter(string $dirPath): \Generator {
    if (!is_dir($dirPath)) return;
    $dh = opendir($dirPath);
    if (!$dh) return;
    try {
        while (($file = readdir($dh)) !== false) {
            if ($file !== "." && $file !== "..") {
                yield $dirPath . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            }
        }
    } finally { closedir($dh); }
}

<?php
function quick_sort(array &$a, int $l=0, int $r=null): array {
    if($r===null) $r=count($a)-1;
    if($l>=$r) return $a;
    $p=$a[$l+r>>1]; $i=$l-1; $j=$r+1;
    while(true){
        while($a[++$i]<$p); while($a[--$j]>$p);
        if($i>=$j) break;
        [$a[$i],$a[$j]]=[$a[$j],$a[$i]];
    }
    quick_sort($a,$l,$j); quick_sort($a,$j+1,$r);
    return $a;
}

    $m=(int)($n/2);
    $left=merge_sort(array_slice($a,0,$m));
    $right=merge_sort(array_slice($a,$m));

}
function merge(array $l,array $r):array{
    $res=[]; $i=$j=0;
    while($i<count($l)&&$j<count($r)) $res[]=$l[$i]<=$r[$j]?$l[$i++]:$r[$j++];

}

description-en: Segment tree for range sum and point update in O(log n)
code:
<?php
class SegmentTree{
    private array $tree; private int $n;
    public function __construct(array $a){$this->n=count($a);$this->tree=array_fill(0,$this->n*4,0);$this->build($a,0,0,$this->n-1);}
    private function build(array $a,int $node,int $l,int $r):void{
        if($l==$r){$this->tree[$node]=$a[$l];return;}
        $m=($l+$r)>>1;$this->build($a,$node*2+1,$l,$m);$this->build($a,$node*2+2,$m+1,$r);$this->tree[$node]=$this->tree[$node*2+1]+$this->tree[$node*2+2];
    }
    public function update(int $idx,int $val):void{$this->updateR(0,0,$this->n-1,$idx,$val);}
    private function updateR(int $node,int $l,int $r,int $idx,int $val):void{
        if($l==$r){$this->tree[$node]=$val;return;}
        $m=($l+$r)>>1;if($idx<=$m)$this->updateR($node*2+1,$l,$m,$idx,$val);else $this->updateR($node*2+2,$m+1,$r,$idx,$val);$this->tree[$node]=$this->tree[$node*2+1]+$this->tree[$node*2+2];
    }
    public function query(int $ql,int $qr):int{return $this->queryR(0,0,$this->n-1,$ql,$qr);}
    private function queryR(int $node,int $l,int $r,int $ql,int $qr):int{
        if($ql>$r||$qr<$l) return 0;
        if($ql<=$l&&$r<=$qr) return $this->tree[$node];
        $m=($l+$r)>>1;return $this->queryR($node*2+1,$l,$m,$ql,$qr)+$this->queryR($node*2+2,$m+1,$r,$ql,$qr);
    }
}

code:
<?php
function heap_sort(array &$arr): void {
    $n = count($arr);
    for ($i = (int)($n/2) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) heapify($arr, $n, $i);
    for ($i = $n - 1; $i > 0; $i--) {
        [$arr[0], $arr[$i]] = [$arr[$i], $arr[0]];
        heapify($arr, $i, 0);
    }
}
function heapify(array &$arr, $n, $i): void {
    $largest = $i; $l = 2*$i+1; $r = 2*$i+2;
    if ($l < $n && $arr[$l] > $arr[$largest]) $largest = $l;
    if ($r < $n && $arr[$r] > $arr[$largest]) $largest = $r;
    if ($largest != $i) { [$arr[$i], $arr[$largest]] = [$arr[$largest], $arr[$i]]; heapify($arr, $n, $largest); }
}

description-en: Shell sort with diminishing gap
code:
<?php
function shell_sort(array &$arr): void {
    $n = count($arr);
    for ($gap = (int)($n/2); $gap > 0; $gap = (int)($gap/2)) {
        for ($i = $gap; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $tmp = $arr[$i]; $j = $i;
            while ($j >= $gap && $arr[$j - $gap] > $tmp) { $arr[$j] = $arr[$j - $gap]; $j -= $gap; }
            $arr[$j] = $tmp;
        }
    }
}

function counting_sort(array $arr, int $max): array {
    $count = array_fill(0, $max + 1, 0);
    foreach ($arr as $v) $count[$v]++;
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $max; $i++) $count[$i] += $count[$i - 1];
    $out = array_fill(0, count($arr), 0);
    for ($i = count($arr) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) { $out[--$count[$arr[$i]] = $arr[$i]; }
    return $out;
}

class RedisPool {

    private int $port;

        $this->host = $host;
        $this->port = $port;
        $this->maxConnections = $maxConnections;
    }

        if (!empty($this->pool)) {
            return array_pop($this->pool);
        }
        $redis = new Redis();
        $redis->connect($this->host, $this->port);

        }
    }
}

description-en: JWT token encode and decode without external library
code:
<?php
function base64url_encode(string $data): string {
    return rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($data), '+/', '-_'));
}
function base64url_decode(string $data): string {
    return base64_decode(strtr($data, '-_', '+/'));
}
function jwt_encode(array $payload, string $secret): string {
    $header = base64url_encode(json_encode(['alg'=>'HS256','typ'=>'JWT']));
    $payload['iat'] = $payload['iat'] ?? time();
    $payload = base64url_encode(json_encode($payload));
    $sig = base64url_encode(hash_hmac('sha256', "$header.$payload", $secret, true));
    return "$header.$payload.$sig";
}
function jwt_decode(string $token, string $secret): ?array {
    $parts = explode('.', $token);
    if (count($parts) !== 3) return null;
    [$h, $p, $s] = $parts;
    $expected = base64url_encode(hash_hmac('sha256', "$h.$p", $secret, true));
    if (!hash_equals($expected, $s)) return null;
    return json_decode(base64url_decode($p), true);
}

code:
<?php
class BloomFilter {
    private int $size;
    private array $bits = [];
    public function __construct(int $size = 1000) { $this->size = $size; $this->bits = array_fill(0, $size, false); }
    private function h1(string $s): int { return abs(crc32($s)) % $this->size; }
    private function h2(string $s): int { return abs(md5($s, true)[0] . md5($s, true)[1]) % $this->size; }
    private function h3(string $s): int { return abs(ord($s[0]) * 31 + ord($s[strlen($s)-1])) % $this->size; }
    public function add(string $item): void { $this->bits[$this->h1($item)] = $this->bits[$this->h2($item)] = $this->bits[$this->h3($item)] = true; }
    public function contains(string $item): bool { return $this->bits[$this->h1($item)] && $this->bits[$this->h2($item)] && $this->bits[$this->h3($item)]; }
}

description-zh: 滑动窗口限流器
description-en: Sliding window rate limiter
code:
<?php
class RateLimiter {
    private array $requests = [];
    public function allow(string $key, int $max, int $window): bool {
        $now = time();
        if (!isset($this->requests[$key])) $this->requests[$key] = [];
        $this->requests[$key] = array_filter($this->requests[$key], fn($t) => $t > $now - $window);
        if (count($this->requests[$key]) >= $max) return false;
        $this->requests[$key][] = $now;
        return true;
    }
}

description-zh: 用授权码换取 Access Token
description-en: Exchange authorization code for access token
code:
<?php
function oauth2_token(string $code, string $clientId, string $clientSecret, string $redirectUri, string $tokenUrl): ?array {
    $ch = curl_init($tokenUrl);
    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_POST => true,
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query([
            'grant_type' => 'authorization_code',
            'code' => $code,
            'client_id' => $clientId,
            'client_secret' => $clientSecret,
            'redirect_uri' => $redirectUri
        ]),
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Accept: application/json']
    ]);
    $res = curl_exec($ch);
    if (!$res) return null;
    return json_decode($res, true);
}
